scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:desktop && bun run build:rust
scripts.test: bun run test:desktop && bun run test:rust
scripts.lint: bun run lint:desktop && bun run lint:rust
scripts.format: bun run --cwd apps/desktop format && cargo fmt --all
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd apps/desktop && bun install --cwd apps/design
scripts.clean: cargo clean && rm -rf apps/desktop/dist apps/desktop/node_modules apps/design/dist apps/design/node_modules
